phase_extension.reason: First screen rejected all original-gain variants under joint angle/velocity/body omega guardrails

phase_extension.validation_extra: nonzero rear/steer initial velocities; 15ms input start; every 5ms macro endpoint compared in addition to original 10ms ranking
phase_extension.claim_boundary: numerical actuator response adapter, not physical equivalence or frozen policy success
